messages:
Jamie: quick sync on Orion POC: steady chat ~300 qps (short convos ~25 tokens) + embedding spikes ~200 r/s for 30m nightly. They want a reserved-gpu commit + autoscale/burst controls. Can we sketch ops + pricing?
Liam: baseline perf note: with our runtime a warmed A100-equivalent handles ~50 qps for this chat mix. Baseline GPUs = ceil(300/50)=6. Recommend reserve 9 to cover AZ failover + embedding headroom. Autoscale to 14 for spikes.
Pat: quantized option (int8) gives ~1.5x throughput -> baseline could be 435 GPUs, but call out quality regression risk and require evaluation set pass.
Mika: their p95 target for chat?
Jamie: p95 < 240ms. embeddings OK up to 2s. They also require BYOK KMS and 90d logs in the security questionnaire.
Liam: burst billing control: implement burst credits per GPU/day and throttle/fallback once exhausted. Example policy: 
```
burst_policy: credits_per_gpu_day: 600s fallback_model: embed-small-quantized throttle: true
```
Liam: autoscale snippet: 
```
autoscale:
  reserved: 9
  max: 14
  burst_credits_per_gpu_day: 600
  fallback_model: chat-small-quantized
```
Mika: preheat runbook (short): 1) 10% traffic 30m canary, 2) 50% 45m, 3) full ramp. Run KV-cache warm calls and embedding batches between stages. Use smoke checks for p95 at each step.
Pat: quick preheat command: `for i in $(seq 1 1800); do curl -s -X POST $ENDPOINT -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"warm","max_tokens":8}'; sleep 1; done`
deploy-bot: preheat canary posted - p95=220ms, p99=470ms, canary OK :white_check_mark:
Jamie: sales asked pricing tiers for 6mo vs 12mo. Option ideas: conservative (9 reserved A100, autoscale 14, 12mo discount), lean quantized (5 reserved, autoscale 10, higher discount + quality review). Also offer H100 premium to reduce reserved count ~25% with pricing uplift.
Mika: action items: 1) @liam produce numeric SKU quote for A100, H100, and quantized path by EOD. 2) @pat draft preheat checklist and sample YAML policies. 3) @jamie request hourly spike traces from customer and confirm KMS provider. We'll reconvene after quotes.
